items.title: BMO Online Banking user locked out + password reset (Oct 6)
items.summary: Albert mailbox: BMO reported Albert Ngo locked out after unsuccessful logins and sent two password-reset emails (one containing a temporary password, not reproduced here). Confirm the lockout and reset were Albert's own; if not, call BMO.
